topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

row.authors: Adolfsson L, Solymosi K, Andersson MX, Keresztes Á, Uddling J, Schoefs B, Spetea C
row.notes: Significantly larger leaflet area in AM vs control at 3 wpi. Mycorrhization conditions: M%=30±7, F%=62±7, A%=17±5.

topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

row.notes: 12-month measurement. AMF + Trichoderma combined; confounded.

topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome

4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported

topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

row.title: Increasing flavonoid concentrations in root exudates enhance associations between arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi and an invasive plant
row.authors: Baoliang Tian, Yingchun Pei, Wei Huang, Jianqing Ding, Evan Siemann
row.treatment_description: Introduced populations (US) with higher natural AMF colonization, 90 days
row.control_description: Native populations (China) with lower natural AMF colonization, 90 days
row.notes: PICO MISMATCH: This is NOT an AMF inoculation experiment. Comparison is between introduced (US) and native (China) populations of an invasive tree grown in non-sterilized field soil with naturally-occurring AMF. US populations have higher natural AMF colonization correlated with higher mass. n values (10, 12) are number of populations, not individual plants (3 seedlings harvested per population per time). SE is standard error of population means. At 60 days masses were similar; difference emerged at 90 days only (Origin P=0.0139, Table 1 ANOVA).

moderators.mod_sterilized_soil: No (natural field soil from corn field)
moderators.mod_population_origin_comparison: US introduced (10 pops) vs China native (12 pops)

topic_brief.title: Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi inoculation effects on crop yield
topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect

topic_brief.research_question: Does inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) increase crop yield, and how does the effect vary by crop type and P availability?
topic_brief.population_description: Crop plants inoculated with AMF in field or greenhouse experiments
tc_confusion_warnings: Treatment is +AMF (inoculated), Control is -AMF (non-inoculated)
In factorial AMF x P designs, extract each AMF vs non-AMF at matching P level
Sterilized soil control may behave differently from field soil - note if soil was sterilized
Some papers compare AMF species to each other - we want each vs the NON-AMF control
Root colonization % is NOT the yield outcome - extract yield/biomass as the primary outcome
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY AMF species x crop x P level combination separately
2. Treatment = +AMF (inoculated); Control = -AMF (non-inoculated or sterilized)
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs the non-AMF control
4. Get variance (SE/SD) and sample size (n/replicates)
5. Record AMF species and P fertilization level
6. Biomass outcomes acceptable when grain yield not reported
topic_brief.benchmark_notes: Overall +23% plant biomass; C4 grasses +57%, forbs +32%, C3 grasses +14%, woody plants +18%; Low P: larger effect; High P: reduced effect
